title: Characterization of the large coefficient family
statement: For a Boolean function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube and a subset $S$ of its coordinates, $S$ belongs to the family of large-coefficient sets associated to $f$ if and only if $S$ is contained in the selected Friedgut coordinates of $f$, its cardinality is at most the variance-based Friedgut degree of $f$, and $S$ is nonempty.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
$S$ is a finite subset of the $n$ coordinates
